verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a team chat and collaboration product, since comparable tools offer on-prem deployment, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Teams can be self-hosted. The docs cover only extending Teams (bots, tabs, webhooks, Graph APIs) and deploying your own apps to Azure, which are developer building blocks and adjacent features, not hosting the core product. The community remark about Teams being installed on a server concerns an unwanted client install, not running the service on your own infrastructure.
